text: {"lessons":["My account can fall even after a positive month, so I should focus on preserving savings and limiting large swings rather than chasing short-term gains.","A price’s gain or loss versus my average cost is not, by itself, a reason to sell; I should make each decision deliberately and in light of my retirement needs.","I have traded infrequently so far, and I should avoid unnecessary trading while keeping a balanced portfolio and enough cash for living expenses."]}
